# Solid Hyperobjects

Last Updated: 2026-10-05

Owns solid-geometry cartridges: manifests, source geometry, presets and provenance.
Yantra4D owns the platform/render service; hyperobjects-spec owns shared schemas
and validators; soft-hyperobjects owns soft pattern representations.

Start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [README.md](README.md), and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Read [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for licensing
exceptions and [the public repository boundary](docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md)
before publishing. The [full context map](llms-full.txt) explains verification.

Use the exact `SPEC_PIN` from [CI](.github/workflows/ci.yml), not a remembered
package revision. Check each changed cartridge with `y4d-spec check ./<slug>
--render --require-openscad --parity --openscad-path libs --openscad-path .`.
The repository root resolves `commons-lib/...`; a path inside that directory does
not. [Keytag's font contract](keytag/docs/README.md) demonstrates why text must
name an installed family explicitly.

[Assemblies](assemblies/README.md) compose cartridges with keystone standard
parts (ASM-1). Assembly A, the [Voron 2.4-class 350 motion system](assemblies/voron-2-4-class-350-motion-frame/README.md),
is posable (ASM-1 §9). Its ten printed cartridges carry graph twins (graph format
1.1), which `--parity` checks against their scripts. Contracts in other
repositories: see [Related repositories and contracts](README.md#related-repositories-and-contracts).
Dated status (2026-10-05: open PRs in merge order, next steps): [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md).

A schema pass is not a render pass. Kernel-dependent skips and queued jobs are
not acceptance. Require the exact-head Linux result, preserve strict geometry
gates, and distinguish a commons source merge from a platform pin and release.
